articles.title: Balrampur Chini's Rs 3,100-cr bio-plastic plant to start commercial operations in Jan-Mar: CMD
articles.description: Balrampur Chini Mills plans to start commercial production at its Rs 3,100-crore bio-plastic plant next quarter. The company has invested around Rs 2,400 crore in the project so far, with expectations for significant future revenue. This plant will produce Poly Lactic Acid bioplastics from renewable resources such as sugarcane and corn starch. In addition, the company reported a 90 percent increase in net profit in the last quarter.
